title: Sprint 4 — Task Updates, Deletions, and Filtering
description: Implement task modifications, completion toggles, deletions, and status query parameter filtering.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 - Update Task & Status Toggle API
tickets.description:
Build `PUT` and `PATCH /api/tasks/<id>` to allow updating a task's title, description, or completion status (`is_completed`).

### Request Header
`Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`

### Request Body (Partial or Full)
```json
{
  "title": "Updated Title",
  "is_completed": true
}
```

### Requirements
1. Protect endpoint with `@token_required`.
2. Verify the task belongs to `current_user`. Return `404 Not Found` if missing or unauthorized.
3. Update fields if provided in request body. If `title` is provided, validate it is not empty.
4. Update `task.updated_at` to current time.
5. Commit to database and return `200 OK` with `{"message": "Task updated successfully", "task": task.to_dict()}`.
learning_objectives: Support partial and full REST resource updates.
Update timestamp columns on record changes.

tasks.title: Return HTTP 200 with updated task payload.

common_mistakes: Allowing empty string titles to overwrite valid titles.
Not committing the session changes to the database.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 - Delete Task API
tickets.description:
Build `DELETE /api/tasks/<id>` to allow users to permanently delete a task.

### Request Header
`Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`

### Requirements
1. Protect endpoint with `@token_required`.
2. Verify the task belongs to `current_user`. Return `404 Not Found` if missing or unauthorized.
3. Delete the task record from the database.
4. Return `200 OK` with `{"message": "Task deleted successfully"}` (or `204 No Content`).
learning_objectives: Implement resource deletion in REST APIs.
Enforce horizontal authorization on DELETE requests.
Handle database deletion operations in SQLAlchemy.

tasks.title: Enforce ownership authorization on task deletion.
Delete task from database using `db.session.delete(task)` and commit.

common_mistakes: Deleting another user's task without ownership validation.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 - Task Filtering by Status Query Parameter
tickets.description:
Enhance `GET /api/tasks` to support query parameter filtering by completion status: `?completed=true` or `?completed=false`.

### Requirements
1. If `?completed=true` is passed in URL query string, return only tasks where `is_completed == True`.
2. If `?completed=false` is passed, return only tasks where `is_completed == False`.
3. If `completed` parameter is omitted or empty, return all tasks for the current user as before.
4. All tasks must still strictly belong to `current_user`.
learning_objectives: Read and parse URL query parameters using `request.args`.
Apply dynamic SQL filtering based on request criteria.
Combine user authorization with custom filtering conditions.

tasks.title: Apply dynamic filtering on `Task.query` based on parameter value.
Return filtered tasks list with HTTP 200.

common_mistakes: Treating string `'false'` as boolean truthy in Python (`bool('false') == True`). Compare string values: `val.lower() == 'true'`.
Overriding user ownership filter when applying status filter.
